messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — RedTeamX asked to expand the upcoming pen test to include our private VPC deployment (customer-owned KMS) and the Dedicated routing layer. Proposed window: Jun 2-4. Who can own access windows and KMS onboarding?
Jordan Patel: I can coordinate RBAC windows. Need exact scope (namespaces/services) + least-priv role we can give.
Maya Chen: Scope = infra/vpc-private, serving/gateway-dedicated, and the kms-proxy service. No PROD DB access.
Alex Rivera: For KMS, we need a read-only envelope-encrypt/decrypt test key. Prefer ephemeral wrapping keys via the KMS proxy. Can we create an assessment key with time-limited grants?
Li Wong: Yes — we can mint an ephemeral CMK alias = alias/pen-test-2026 and grant a 72h grant. Need to update key policy to allow grant APIs from the pen-test principal.
Jordan Patel: Sounds good. Action items: 1) Maya to confirm start/end times. 2) Alex/Li to create alias + grant. 3) I will create ephemeral RBAC role and S3 evidence bucket with limited retention.
Maya Chen: Proposed start 2026-06-02 09:00 PT, end 2026-06-04 18:00 PT. RedTeamX asked for an evidence upload endpoint and access to our audit logs (sampling only).
Alex Rivera: Audit logs — we can provide a sampled export for the window to a pre-signed S3 bucket. We'll redact sensitive fields. Example export command we plan to use: ```aws logs export-task --log-group-name /redwood/audit --from <ts> --to <ts> --destination my-pen-test-bucket```
Sam (sec-bot): Reminder: Create an incident runbook stub for 'pen-test-observed-finding' to ensure triage flow available during test.
Li Wong: On KMS: I'll prepare a key policy patch and a grant flow. Two questions for RedTeamX: (a) will they call Decrypt directly or only EnvelopeDecrypt via the proxy? (b) Do they need HSM-backed attestations?
RedTeamX Bot: RedTeamX confirms EnvelopeDecrypt via proxy only. No attestation requirement, but will request timing windows for key usage.
Jordan Patel: For RBAC we should create an ephemeral role cluster-pen-test with these rules: ```- allow: read:logs, describe:clusters, get:pods - deny: write, exec,bash``` We'll attach a session duration of 12h and rotate creds after 24h.
Maya Chen: Also need to lock down routing fallbacks — don't let traffic be routed to production models accidentally. Add a rollout guard in the routing policy for test principals.
Alex Rivera: Will add a gating flag in runtime: `routing.allow_pen_test=true` scoped to the ephemeral role. We'll also capture latency and token-level traces for the window.
Jordan Patel: Who will be on-call for triage during the test? Recommend Maya (security PM), Alex (eng-runtime), Li (kms), plus one SRE on weekend shift.
Maya Chen: I'll own triage coordination and post-test findings summary. Please add all remediation tickets to the 'pen-test-remediation' board and tag with severity + CVSS.
Li Wong: After the test, we should schedule a retest slot? Proposal: Retest window 2 weeks after initial findings are closed or mitigated.
Jordan Patel: Agreed. I'll reserve Jun 20-22 for retest tentatively. If small fixes, we can do ad-hoc retest earlier.
Alex Rivera: One more: export of audit logs must include request IDs and principal names. We'll ensure PII redaction rules applied.
Maya Chen: Thanks — please update the checklist in Confluence and ping @eng-sre for bucket lifecycle policy (14-day retention).
Jordan Patel: I'll open the tickets now and post links here when done.
Sam (sec-bot): Automated checklist: RBAC role created, KMS alias created, evidence bucket pre-signed URL generated.
Maya Chen: Great work. Last ask — include the remediation SLAs in the kickoff: Critical = 48h, High = 7d, Medium/Low = 30d. RedTeamX agreed to provide reproducible PoCs for each finding.
Jordan Patel: Tickets created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-SEC-3221 (KMS alias & grant), RD-SEC-3222 (ephemeral RBAC role), RD-SEC-3223 (evidence bucket + export). I'll follow up with PR links.
Maya Chen: Dropping runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/PenTest+Runbook
Li Wong: I'll post the key policy diff in the ticket shortly.
Alex Rivera: I'll open a runtime PR to add the routing gate and a small test harness for simulated requests.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — we should reconvene 2026-05-26 10:00 PT for final pre-test sign-off. :thumbsup:
